name: How long does a typical door installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical door installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a door installation varies based on the type of door and the complexity of the project. A standard pre-hung interior door can often be installed within a few hours. Exterior doors, such as a new entry door or a basic sliding patio door, generally take a half to a full day, especially if frame adjustments are needed. More complex installations, like custom-sized doors, French doors, or significant structural modifications around the opening, could extend to one or two full days. Your installer can provide a more precise timeline after assessing the specific job.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies; a standard interior door might take a few hours, while exterior doors or complex custom installations could take a half to two days, depending on the project's complexity.
